title: Elevated 5xx errors on cloud-api
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-07-26 16:09-21:09: cloud-api: 610 of 740 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-07-26 16:09 and 2026-07-26 21:09 UTC (peak error ratio 0.95 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 1.945 s vs baseline band up to 0.453 s.
error_templates: Unexpected exception while calling <*> HTTPError: 503 Server Error: Service Unavailable

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} was a routine dependency bump; the new S3 client sends checksum headers the bucket policy denies.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} upgrades the library: the new S3 client sends checksum headers the bucket policy denies.
_templates.remediation: Roll back {svc} {version_to} -> {version_from}; pin the previous version in {file} until the upgrade is tested against the real dependency.

culprit.diff:
@@ -309,2 +309,2 @@ go.mod
 require (
-	github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3 v1.40.0
+	github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3 v1.58.0

rca.macro: Deploy v1.17.0 of image-svc was a routine dependency bump; the new S3 client sends checksum headers the bucket policy denies.
rca.micro: images/go.mod:310 upgrades the library: the new S3 client sends checksum headers the bucket policy denies.
rca.remediation: Roll back image-svc v1.17.0 -> v1.16.0; pin the previous version in images/go.mod until the upgrade is tested against the real dependency.

action_items: Add a regression test covering go.mod (images/go.mod).
Alert on the error signature `<*> <*> <*> HTTP/1.1" status: <*> len: <*> time: <*>`.
